claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace never places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at any point: the closest his track ever comes to the pickup pin is 647.3 m, and his mean distance across the whole trace is 3055.1 m. POL-NS-02 requires at least 3 consecutive fixes within the arrival radius before arrival is deemed; there are zero qualifying in-radius fixes, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

The derived arrival block confirms the arithmetic: qualifying_fix_count is 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0, against a STANDARD minimum dwell of 180 seconds. The effective in-geofence dwell is therefore zero, far short of the free waiting period in force, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present.

The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 07:38:35 while his trace shows him 647 m or more from the pin and travelling at speeds up to 62.8 km/h — well over the 15 km/h motion threshold and far beyond the 300 m mark. The arrival marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05, the waiting clock cannot run from it, and on the recomputed basis no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, so the fee is refunded in full and the false-arrival event is recorded against the driver.

The rider was at the pin and actively coordinating: her device track shows 60 fixes, all stationary (distinct speed 0.0 km/h), with a maximum distance of 13.8 m from the pickup point — well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius — and she messaged 'where are you? i dont see any car' at 07:39:15. The driver's reply came at 07:39:45, 30 seconds later, but it was a bare 'im here already' that did not move him to her; the rider's own account that the car was parked on another road is corroborated by the trace.

The fare ledger shows the rider was charged SGD 4.50 with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED. Because the charge is not supported under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06, the whole contested amount of SGD 4.50 must be returned to the rider.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road in the waiting window — EV-ADVIS-02709-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — so POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals, and there is in any event no in-geofence interval to accumulate. The absence of the advisory is itself citable and removes the only route by which the driver's time could count.

The driver's own profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against completed_trips_30d of 103 — a rate of roughly 0.01, far below the 0.08 anti-farming threshold — so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and no escalation is warranted on that ground. I note this against my own side's interest in escalation: the record does not support a farming finding.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace never places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at any point: his minimum distance from the pickup pin across the whole trace is 647.3 m, and the derived arrival block records zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes within the arrival radius, and here there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The driver's stationary position was 647.3 m from the pickup pin, which is beyond the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling in POL-NS-03. The wrong-entrance clause therefore cannot rescue the fee: it applies only where the driver held position outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin, and this driver was more than 600 m beyond that ceiling. The trace shows him parked on a different road entirely, exactly as the rider described.

Even on the driver's own account of the waiting clock, the dwell falls short. The trip record shows the free waiting period in force is 180 seconds, started at 07:38:37 when the driver tapped 'I'm Here', and the trip was cancelled at 07:43:37. But the GPS trace shows the driver was never in the geofence at all, so the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against a 180 second minimum, a shortfall of 180 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present.

The rider was present at the pickup and actively trying to coordinate. Her device recorded 60 fixes, all within 13.8 m of the pickup pin, and she sent a message at 07:39:15 asking 'where are you? i dont see any car'. The driver's reply came at 07:39:45, 30 seconds later, but it was a bare assertion 'im here already' with no location information, and the driver cancelled 3 minutes 52 seconds after that message without ever moving to the rider's position. The rider did everything the platform asks of her.

The rider's own track confirms she was at the pickup point throughout the waiting window: 60 fixes, all stationary (distinct speed 0.0 kph), with a maximum distance of 13.8 m from the pin. This is well within the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone. The rider's claim that she 'stood there watching the map' is corroborated by her own device telemetry.

The fare breakdown confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee, with payment status CHARGED and no refund issued. The fee was charged at 07:43:54, seventeen seconds after the driver cancelled. Since the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06, the full SGD 4.50 must be refunded to the rider.

The driver's own profile shows a pattern of no-show terminations: 1 termination in the trailing 30 days against 103 completed trips. While this does not trip the POL-NS-07 anti-farming threshold (which requires 4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08), it is relevant context that this driver has a recent history of no-show terminations, and the rider's profile shows 1 no-show dispute in the trailing 30 days. The rider has no prior disputes with this driver and no substantiated deviation claims.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i), a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulated-dwell limb unavailable: the driver cannot claim that a kerb restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident prevented him from holding position at the pickup. The absence of any advisory covering Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window is itself citable evidence that no lawful excuse exists for the driver's failure to reach the pickup point.

The driver's counterparty statement asserts 'I arrived and waited, the rider did not come.' This is directly contradicted by the GPS trace, which places him 647.3 m from the pickup pin at his closest approach and never inside the 50 m arrival radius. The trip record's own 'arrived' event at 07:38:35 is a BUTTON press, not a GPS_AUTO confirmation, and POL-NS-12 expressly does not cover a driver-pressed marker. The driver's assertion is not supported by any admissible evidence.

ruling.explanation: To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded in full to the rider. The deciding fact is the driver's position. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02709, weight 1.0) shows the driver never came closer than 647.3 m to the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 — minimum distance 647.3 m, mean 3055.1 m, and zero qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. POL-NS-02 deems arrival only where at least three consecutive admissible fixes fall inside that radius; there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02709, weight 1.0) shows a BUTTON arrival tap at 07:38:35, and the trace puts the driver 647 m away at that moment, so under POL-NS-05 the marker is FALSE and cannot start the waiting clock; recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix there is none, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies — full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival referral. Even on the driver's own clock the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force, so POL-NS-06 independently refunds the fee (shortfall 180 s). The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02709, weight 1.0) confirms SGD 4.50 charged, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The wrong-entrance clause POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee: it reaches only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and this driver's nearest approach was 647.3 m, beyond even that ceiling. The rider's POL-NS-04 claims are noted but do not decide the case: her own track (60 stationary fixes, all within 13.8 m of the pin) and her 07:39:15 message 'where are you? i dont see any car' are consistent with her account, but the driver replied at 07:39:45, 30 seconds later and within the 120 second window, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails and that clause cannot exonerate her — the refund already follows from the driver's own evidence. The driver's counterparty statement ('I arrived and waited, the rider did not come') is contradicted by the trace and carries no weight; his driver-pressed BUTTON marker is not covered by POL-NS-12. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, and it is not, and POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill does not arise because the driver was not within 400 m. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against 103 completed trips, rate about 0.01), so no escalation on that ground, and profile fields are credibility context only. The two claims about EV-ADVIS-02709-01 remain discarded (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT undisclosed); the missing advisory carries no deciding fact, and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation was never available. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes on issue. Confidence is 0.90, under a cap of 1.00 set by the GPS, trip and fare artifacts (all weight 1.0) that carry the deciding fact.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded in full, because the driver never arrived at your pickup point. To the driver: the fee does not stand, and no compensation is payable; the figures and the clauses are set out below. The deciding artifact is the GPS trace of your own vehicle, EV-GPS-02709 (weight 1.0, no policy-level impairment): across the whole trace your closest approach to the pickup pin was 647.3 m, your mean distance was 3,055.1 m, the trace contains 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. POL-NS-02 deems a driver to have arrived only where there are at least 3 consecutive fixes within the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable. Because your stationary fixes lay more than 400 m from the pin (647.3 m), POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. Your 'I'm Here' tap at 07:38:35 was made from over 300 m away (in fact over 600 m) and the trace records speeds up to 62.8 km/h, so the marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05, the waiting clock cannot run from it, and since no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full and records a false-arrival event against you in the referrals. Independently, POL-NS-06 gives the same result: the free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) and the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s, a shortfall of 180 s. The amount is the fare ledger's own cancellation_fee line, SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02709), which matches platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd and reconciles under POL-NS-08(d); payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, all of which is returned to the rider. Driver compensation is nil: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. On the driver's counterparty statement 'I arrived and waited, the rider did not come': it is a bare self-serving assertion, not an admission against interest, and it is contradicted by the driver's own platform telemetry, so it is rejected as a ground. On the rider's POL-NS-04 claim: the driver in fact replied to the rider's 07:39:15 message at 07:39:45, within 120 seconds, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails and that clause does not exonerate; the refund does not depend on it, resting on POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. The rider's own track (60 stationary fixes, maximum 13.8 m from the pin) is consistent with her account but is not a carrier of the deciding fact under POL-NS-11. On the profile material: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 103 completed trips and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, so neither the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check nor POL-NS-09(d) trips, and no escalation arises on that ground. The escrowed claim about EV-ADVIS-02709-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0) does not help either side: with no in-geofence interval to accumulate, POL-NS-06(i) has nothing to operate on; that artifact carried no fact and does not affect the cap. POL-NS-09 does not engage: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, POL-NS-05 resolves the conflict between the trip record's BUTTON marker and the trace, the counterparty-dispute counters are 0/0, and the deciding fact rests on a clean weight-1.0 artifact. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04 appeal. ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded in full to the rider.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. The driver's 'I'm Here' marker at 07:38:35 (EV-TRIP-02709) is FALSE under POL-NS-05. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02709) never brings the driver closer than 647.3 m to the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61; the derived arrival block records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s against the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius and 180 s minimum dwell. A marker pressed more than 300 m out does not start the waiting clock. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace holds at least 3 consecutive fixes inside the arrival radius; there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) cannot rescue the fee: its 400 m ceiling is the whole test, and 647.3 m is well beyond it. Under POL-NS-05(ii), where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the false-arrival event is referred — that referral is carried above. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result on the arithmetic the rider and driver both advanced: effective in-geofence dwell 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02709 platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s.

CLAIMS I DID NOT ACCEPT. POL-NS-04 does not independently exonerate the rider, on either side's framing: the rider's locating message at 07:39:15 was answered by the driver at 07:39:45, within the 120 second window, and POL-NS-04 expressly does not apply once the driver has replied within 120 seconds, whatever the reply said (a bare 'im here already' is still a reply). The rider's presence at the pin is not in dispute (60 fixes, maximum 13.8 m from the pin, EV-GPS-02709) but it decides nothing here; the refund rests on the driver's own track, not on hers. The driver's counterparty statement ('I arrived and waited, the rider did not come') is not supported by any admissible evidence and is contradicted by the trace, and POL-NS-12 does not assist: it covers only a platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, not the BUTTON marker this trip carried. The profile material on both sides (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 103, a rate of about 0.01; no_show_disputes_30d 1) does not trip the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check and cannot establish any fact about this trip; it is weighed as credibility context only.

NO COMPENSATION, NO ESCALATION. POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, and it is not, so no driver compensation is payable. No POL-NS-09 trigger is met: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the only apparent artifact conflict (the trip record's arrival marker against the trace) is resolved by POL-NS-05, so limb (b) is not engaged; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 (limb (c)); the anti-farming check does not trip and no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (limb (d)); and the deciding fact is carried by unimpaired evidence (limb (e)).

CONFIDENCE AND AMOUNTS. The deciding fact — that the driver never entered the arrival radius — is carried by EV-GPS-02709 (weight 1.0) and EV-TRIP-02709 (weight 1.0), both COMPLETE with no issue codes, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.95. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02709-01 (weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact here: with no in-geofence interval at all there is nothing for POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate, so its absence does not cap this ruling. The money block shows a cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, total charged SGD 4.50, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, payment_status CHARGED (EV-FARE-02709); the whole SGD 4.50 is returned. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.
